company.shortDescription: Darrow is a legal data security platform that ingests amounts of publicly-available documents to search for class action litigation.
company.description: Darrow is an AI-powered justice intelligence platform that scans real-world data to detect harmful events, determine the number of victims, predict the outcome, and assess the financial value of a case. Using generative AI, Darrow detects egregious legal violations, matching plaintiff's lawyers with their next big case so they can stop spending valuable hours on business development and focus primarily on litigation.
